title: Pure Onomat
summary: Pure Onomat Xyz build uniting Dododo with the Zubaba, Gagaga, and Gogogo families it is built around, finishing on Rank 4, Rank 6, and Utopic Future Xyz Monsters. The Gagaga, Gogogo, Zubaba, and Onomat pages open this same list.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic Special Summons itself from the hand alongside a Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, or Dododo monster from your hand or GY and immediately Xyz Summons using those two monsters, matching their Levels without using your Normal Summon.

Dodododo Warrior sends a Dododo monster from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand as a Level 4, and searches a Zubaba monster when detached from an Xyz Monster to activate an effect.

Zubababa Knight searches another Zubaba on summon and searches a Gagaga monster when detached, Gogogo Goblindbergh summons a non-Warrior Gogogo on Normal Summon and searches a Dododo when detached, and Gagaga Ganbara Knight summons itself and a Gagaga from the hand and searches a Gogogo when detached.

summary.title: Opening: Dodododo Warrior + Onomatopaira
steps: Special Summon Dodododo Warrior by sending Dodododwarf Gogogoglove from the Deck to the GY, or activate Onomatopaira or Onomatopickup to search two Onomat monsters from different families.

Revive Dodododwarf Gogogoglove or summon Zubababa Knight and overlay into Gagagaga Girl; detach Dodododo Warrior from Gagagaga Girl to search a Gagaga, Onomat, or Xyz card while Dodododo Warrior triggers in the GY to search a Zubaba.

Use Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic and Onomatokage to field additional Rank 4 or Rank 6 Xyz Monsters, then combine spent Rank 4 Xyz Monsters into Number F0: Utopic Future and Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

summary.title: Onomat Synergy & Spells/Traps
points: Onomatokage is always treated as a Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, and Dododo card, Special Summons itself from the hand or GY while you control any of them, and banishes from the GY to return two Xyz Monsters to the Extra Deck.
Dodododraw sends a Dododo from your hand or field to the GY to draw 2 cards, setting up Gagaga Magic or Zubababancho Gagagacoat to revive that Dododo.
Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction Special Summons itself when the opponent summons from the Extra Deck to Xyz Summon on their turn and zeroes an opposing monster's ATK when detached.

Gagaga Illusion revives a monster matching a Gagaga's Level or Rank and grants an extra Gagaga Normal Summon from the GY, while Gagaga Escape is a Counter Trap that negates a monster effect while you control a Gagaga and can summon a Gagaga from the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses, Payoff & Left out
points: Number F0: Utopic Draco Future, stacked over Number F0: Utopic Future, cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and negates a monster effect once per turn, taking control of that monster if it is on the field.

Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal shields your other cards from targeting and steals an opponent's monster during their turn, while Ryzeal Detonator detaches materials as a Quick Effect to destroy cards on the field.

Number 39: Utopia Beyond zeroes the ATK of all opposing monsters on Rank 6 Xyz Summon, Number 25: Force Focus negates Level 5+ monster effects, and Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon flips Extra Deck monsters face-down.
Left out: The full Ryzeal Main Deck engine from the page's hybrid build is omitted so the Main Deck stays pure Onomat.

allow.Number F0: Utopic Draco Future: The Onomat boss: three same-Rank Xyz Monsters, or on top of Utopic Future.
allow.Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal: The Onomat boss for two same-Rank Xyz Monsters.
allow.Number 39: Utopia Beyond: Rank 6 for Gagaga Magic plus a Level 6 Dododo, as the page's short line shows.
allow.Heroic Champion - Magnum Excalibur: Gagaga Magic names Heroic Champion Xyz Monsters, and this one takes two Level 4 Warriors.
allow.Ryzeal Detonator: Ryzeal Detonator: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.

main: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic

Newest support. From the hand, Special Summons itself with a Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo or Dododo monster from the hand or GY and Xyz Summons with the two at once, matching their Levels. No Normal Summon needed.
Dodododo Warrior
Sends a Dododo from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself as a Level 4. Detached for an Xyz effect: searches a Zubaba monster.
Zubababa Knight
On summon, searches another Zubaba (taking its Level) or destroys a Level 4 or lower Defense Position monster. Detached: searches a Gagaga monster.
Gogogo Goblindbergh
Normal Summoned: summons a non-Warrior Gogogo, such as Dodododwarf Gogogoglove, from the hand, Deck or GY. Detached: searches a Dododo monster.
Gagaga Ganbara Knight
Reveal a Gagaga in the Extra Deck to Special Summon it and another Gagaga from the hand. Detached: searches a Gogogo monster.
Onomatokage
Counts as all four families. Special Summons itself from the hand or GY while you control one of them; from the GY, returns two Xyz Monsters to the Extra Deck.
Dodododwarf Gogogoglove
Special Summons a Zubaba or Gagaga from the hand, and comes back from the GY while you control another Gogogo or Dododo.
Zubababancho Gagagacoat
Special Summons itself while you control a Zubaba or Gagaga, and revives a Gogogo or Dododo from the GY.
Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction
Newest support. When the opponent summons from the Extra Deck, Special Summons itself and Xyz Summons with one of your monsters on their turn. Detached: zeroes an opposing monster's ATK.
Onomatopaira
Send a card from the hand to search two monsters from different families.
Dodododraw
Sends a Dododo from the hand or field to the GY to draw two; Gagaga Magic can summon that Dododo back from the GY.
Onomatopickup
On activation, searches an Onomat card such as Onomatokage or Onomatopaira; can set all your monsters to one Onomat monster's Level.
Gagaga Illusion
Newest support. Revives a monster at a Gagaga's Level or Rank; from the GY, gives an extra Normal Summon of a Gagaga.
Gagaga Escape
Newest support. Counter Trap: negates a monster effect while you control a Gagaga, then can discard to summon a Gagaga from the Deck.
extra: Rank 4: with an Onomat card as material, detaches to search a Gagaga, Onomat or Xyz card, and the detach sets off the 2025 searchers.
Rank 4: revives an Xyz Monster from the GY with its effects negated.
Two Xyz Monsters of the same Rank: can't be destroyed by battle, and takes the monster it battles.
Three same-Rank Xyz Monsters, or on top of Utopic Future: can't be destroyed, and negates a monster effect and takes that monster.
Two Xyz Monsters of the same Rank: shields your other cards from targeting and takes a monster on the opponent's turn.
Rank 6: zeroes the ATK of every opposing monster when Xyz Summoned.
Rank 6 that negates a Level 5 or higher monster on either turn.
Rank 6 that turns an Extra Deck monster face-down on either turn.
Rank 4 for two Warriors; equips to a monster for 2000 ATK/DEF.
Generic Rank 4 that destroys a Spell/Trap on either turn.
Rank 4: Quick Effect detaches materials to destroy cards on field up to the number of materials detached.
